title: Class 7 object hovers overhead before the helicopter arrives and is seen as chrome with the naked eye
summary: James Valor tells of Class 7 object hovers overhead before the helicopter arrives and is seen as chrome with the naked eye, about February 2025 at Skywatcher field operation (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We had a class 7 NAYA. We decided to raise the air helicopter, to pursue its. Even before the helicopter arrived, he flew up and hovered right above us.
On the fourth Jellyfish Day on the 7th class arrived and hovered over us for about 5 minutes.
tellings.difference: Places it on day four at 800 m for about five minutes with sensors knocked out, without the helicopter-arrival framing.
tellings.link_reason: Day-four class 7 jellyfish hovering over the hill for 5 minutes and knocking out sensors matches the class 7 object hovering overhead story.

as_told.title: On day four a 'jellyfish' hovers over the hill at 800 m and knocks out the sensors

plain: Skywatcher is a private company that says it tries to call up and study unexplained craft. A team member, James Valor, says that during a field operation in early 2025 they picked up what they call a class 7 object, one of their own categories, and decided to send up a helicopter after it. He says that before the helicopter even arrived, the object flew up and hovered right above them, and they could see it as chrome with their own eyes. If true, the team can bring a craft close enough to see without instruments. A second Skywatcher account, from the same interview, says the class 7 object came on the fourth day of the operation, hovered about 800 metres up for around five minutes and knocked out their sensors, without mentioning the helicopter.
